quarterly_data.signal: Demand visibility extended beyond what the Q2 call described. Volozh: 'since we last publicly spoke, actually this sign of this demand went even further. Now we receive orders for first, second quarter of 2028. People are demanding tens of thousands of vGPUs and GPUs now. So we see demand today as unlimited.' On how long the pricing imbalance lasts: 'we were talking about 18 months. Now I think we can easily talk about 24 months, maybe more.'
quarterly_data.figure: orders now arriving for first, second quarter of 2028; elevated pricing window extended from 18 months to 24 months, maybe more

quarterly_data.signal: Palantir partnership announced that day, with Nebius named as a sovereign partner. Volozh: Palantir's enterprise clients want open-weight models trained repeatedly on their own data inside a stack they control, 'controlled down through the models to cloud, to racks, and the data centers. Palantir can control the whole stack. We provide this, and the synergy is that we provide this whole stack up to our token factory, where we run a variety of different open models.' Palantir previously 'used to use hyperscalers for that'. Boroditsky called Palantir 'the credibility and momentum... in the enterprise' and an accelerant to Nebius' enterprise diversification. Volozh cited client Shopify, which trained an open-weight model on its own data in repeated loops and 'achieved the quality which is higher than they had with GPT-5 and 6'.

Generation demand mix across the installed base (CRO Boroditsky): older-generation GPUs are not a fallback but properly matched to simpler workloads — 'RAG infrastructure or text prediction or image creation' — and 'we actually have a list of new customers that are looking for any of the older generation chips that come available. So very robust demand for the older ranges.' On new silicon: 'We're seeing that across the Blackwells. We have a very robust level of interest and adoption that continues to be at a multiple of customers to chips that we have available that actually projects out as well to Vera Rubin interest.' The four landmark Q2 wins are already discussing follow-on clusters: 'In some cases, they are looking for additional GB200s. In all cases, they are all talking to us now about their Vera Rubin platform requirements.'
quarterly_data.figure: a multiple of customers to chips that we have available

quarterly_data.signal: Auction mechanism being extended beyond the first Blackwell experiment: 'We will do more of this. We are told that we will put more capacity on the auction. We now will start experimenting with our longer tail clients, self-serve clients. We have hundreds of thousands of clients which are self-served. Small client with preemptive mechanisms. We will go introduce something like the auction there.' Auction-discovered price then becomes the reference from which Nebius offers discounts or upsells.
quarterly_data.figure: hundreds of thousands of clients which are self-served

quarterly_data.signal: New asset-light partnership line of business, announced 'a couple of months ago', to grow non-linearly alongside owned build: Nebius partners with electricity and data-center companies moving up the stack who have 'physical capacity, plots, electricity, and many of them have access to cheap financing'. Nebius contributes the build knowledge, its racks, its software stack 'and most of all, we can give them the supply. All of our go-to-market organization'. 'We've got a long list of companies wishing to deploy... We're talking about capacity coming online in 2027 and later. We're working with several projects like this.'

Customer mix broadening past AI natives into digital natives and enterprise platform vendors (CRO Boroditsky): named AI natives 'Higgsfield in media and entertainment, or a HeyGen in media production'; digital natives 'like the Shopify deal'; and 'a significant uptick in our pipeline with customers that are platform providers to the enterprise. Some of the most important platform players are looking at us as the first non-hyperscaler supplier.' Vertical initiatives named: physical AI, healthcare, life sciences, media and entertainment, retail and financial services. Value-added layers being added on top of compute: inferencing, post-training, and agentic search via the Tavily acquisition.
